claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lisuride is a potent dopamine/serotonin receptor agonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through its annotated GPCR targets; any modest antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal/off-target stress rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
